tone.target: dark modulated rock tone with gritty crunch
tone.profile: dark modulated rock tone with gritty crunch
tone.summary: A compact signal chain utilizing a Green OD for crunch, followed by an AC30 TB to capture the classic British midrange punch. Modulation (Chorus) adds movement, while Digital Delay provides necessary depth without excessive wash.
